subject: Startups
title: Anti-Dilution Protection
description: A quick, practical guide to Anti-Dilution Protection.

hook.text: Your Series A investors paid $10 per share. A down round prices shares at $5. Anti-dilution protects them—at your cost.

buildup.text: Anti-dilution clauses adjust investors' conversion price downward if the company raises at a lower valuation later.

discovery.text: Broad-based weighted average is the most common type: it partially adjusts the price, softening the blow for founders.

twist.text: Full ratchet is the nuclear option: the investor's entire previous round reprices to the new lower price.

climax.text: Anti-dilution is standard in term sheets. The key is negotiating which type.

punchline.text: Down rounds hurt. Anti-dilution decides who feels the pain.

quiz.question: What is 'full ratchet' anti-dilution?
options: A mechanical tool for equity calculations
It reprices all previous shares to the new lower price
